runtime.source: CLAUDE_EFFORT=high, session model Sonnet 5.5; plan.py start --actor anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5/high

runs_mode: Owner instruction 2026-10-10: no heavy runs in plan-run — write code, verify with targeted SQLite Pest tests only. V2-V4 (PG/MySQL) and V90 (block B barrier) are NOT executed here; they remain deferred to the phase-wide barrier run. Pint/PHPStan/opus-coverage (V80/V81) are not run either unless the owner asks. No mutation tools.
risk_class: security-boundary (signature, secrets, replay tolerance) + data-migration (encrypted secret conversion) + concurrency (settlement vs auto-disable); public API (config keys removed, wire format, actions, command)

core_src: Jobs/Webhooks/DeliverWebhook.php (headers, retry schedule + jitter, failing_since settlement, auto-disable under endpoint lock)

callers_checked: WebhookSigner::sign: DeliverWebhook + tests only (documents/azgard have their own collaboration signing). WebhooksConfig removed accessors (maxAttempts/backoff/disableAfterFailures/*Header): DeliverWebhook + tests; ScanWork* hits are unrelated. Fixture tests/Fixtures/config/vaulter-0.2.php is a 0.2 snapshot and stays untouched.
behaviour: Headers exactly: Content-Type, User-Agent Vaulter-Webhooks/1, webhook-id = payload id, webhook-timestamp, webhook-signature (current secret first, previous while previous_secret_expires_at > now).
Signature v1,base64(HMAC-SHA256("{id}.{ts}.{body}", base64-decoded whsec_ key)) over the exact bytes sent.
Retry delay after n-th failure = retry_schedule[n-1] with +-jitter; attempt count+1 exhausted -> dead.

failing_since set on first failure, cleared on success; >= disable_after_days -> endpoint inactive, disabled_reason failing, pending/failed -> dead (endpoint_disabled), event after commit; locked endpoint row.
Redeliver: delivered|dead + active endpoint -> same row pending, attempts 0.
Migration converts non-whsec_ secrets in one transaction, idempotent, reversible.
